openIssues.span: 稳定笔记 ID 帮助 Anki Forge 和 Anki 识别已有笔记
openIssues.explanation: “帮助……识别”直译自 help X recognize；同句后半“仍会影响最终变化”含义偏虚。
openIssues.proposedFix: 笔记 ID 保持稳定，Anki Forge 和 Anki 才能识别已有笔记，不会把它们当作新笔记；最终更新哪些内容，仍取决于 Anki 的导入设置以及本地是否有更新的修改。

openIssues.span: 发布生成牌组的新版本
openIssues.explanation: “生成牌组”可读作动宾短语“生成（一个）牌组”，和“发布”连读有歧义。
openIssues.proposedFix: 为生成的 Anki 牌组发布新版本：保持稳定笔记 ID，以上一版原始 APKG 为基线构建，并在分发前检查比较结果。

openIssues.span: Mantido pelos mantenedores do Anki Forge
openIssues.issue: The maintenance byline repeats the same root (mantido/mantenedores), which sounds redundant but does not affect the task.
openIssues.suggestion: Mantenedores do Anki Forge · conteúdo revisado em 2026-10-25.

openIssues.span: 脚本支持部分表格软件导出的 UTF-8 BOM
openIssues.explanation: 脚本读取的是带BOM的CSV，直接说支持BOM略省略对象；不会妨碍按示例操作。
openIssues.proposedFix: 脚本支持带 BOM 的 UTF-8 CSV；部分表格软件会以这种格式导出。

openIssues.span: 按字段键引用模板
openIssues.explanation: “模板引用字段键”的方向应更清楚；当前短语可能被读作通过字段键引用整个模板。
openIssues.proposedFix: 模板中的字段键引用

openIssues.span: 把笔记类型的模板、CSS 和媒体放在同一目录中，用于普通卡片或 Cloze 卡片
openIssues.explanation: 省掉了英文中的“加载”一步，“用于”的主语变成目录，句子略松散。
openIssues.proposedFix: 把笔记类型的模板、CSS 和媒体放进同一目录，再加载为普通或 Cloze 笔记类型。

openIssues.span: 从一个模板包加载可复用的 Anki 笔记类型，包含卡片模板、CSS 和媒体，支持普通与 Cloze 卡片，可使用 Rust、Python 或 Node.js。
openIssues.explanation: 四个逗号分句机械串联，“包含卡片模板、CSS 和媒体”挂在模板包还是笔记类型上不清楚；语言简报要求避免这种堆叠。
openIssues.proposedFix: 把卡片模板、CSS 和媒体放进一个模板包，用 Rust、Python 或 Node.js 加载为可复用的 Anki 笔记类型，支持普通卡片与 Cloze 卡片。

openIssues.span: Cloze 填空（挖空）卡片
openIssues.explanation: 三个名称（Cloze、填空、挖空）叠在一起，括号用法与前面“问答（Basic）卡片”不一致，读起来像堆关键词；不影响理解。
openIssues.proposedFix: 用代码批量生成 Anki 问答（Basic）卡片和 Cloze 填空卡片（也叫挖空卡片），无需在 Anki 中逐张添加。

openIssues.span: The examples use Rust; batch import
openIssues.explanation: "batch import below also shows the Python and Node.js calls" is a bare, unlinked section reference without article, and it is the only pointer for Python and Node.js readers. The description promises Rust, Python or Node.js, and the sibling pages changed in the same commit link the Python and Node API sections.
openIssues.proposedFix: The examples use Rust; for Python and Node.js see the [Python API](python/api.md#media-and-occlusion) and [Node API](node/api.md#media-and-image-occlusion). [Batch media import](#batch-media-import) below shows both calls.

openIssues.span: 构造函数保持不会失败
openIssues.explanation: “保持不会失败”机械对应stay infallible，中文宜直接陈述构造函数本身不会失败。
openIssues.proposedFix: 这些构造函数本身不会失败；媒体类别在添加笔记时检查。

openIssues.span: 下文的批量导入也给出了 Python 和 Node.js 调用
openIssues.explanation: “批量导入”未点明是小节，“给出了……调用”缺中心语；描述承诺支持 Rust、Python 或 Node.js，但正文没有像同批修改的其他页面那样给出 Python/Node API 链接。
openIssues.proposedFix: 示例使用 Rust；Python 和 Node.js 的用法见 [Python API](../python/api.md#media-and-occlusion) 和 [Node API](../node/api.md#media-and-image-occlusion)，下文“批量媒体导入”一节也列出了两者的调用方式。

openIssues.span: la sección de importación por lotes también muestra las llamadas de Python y Node.js
openIssues.explanation: The opening pointer to the Python/Node calls names a later section without linking it. That section exists and is discoverable, so this is a minor navigation cost.
openIssues.proposedFix: Link importación por lotes to the existing batch-media-import section.

openIssues.span: Create a structured image-occlusion note from an owned image and rectangles.
openIssues.explanation: The new lead already says image + rectangle coordinates -> note, so this retained opening sentence repeats it straight away. In the lead, "ready to import" modifies "a note", although the APKG is what gets imported.
openIssues.proposedFix: Lead: "... and Anki Forge builds a note with one card per mask, packaged in an APKG you can import." Second paragraph: "The note takes an owned image snapshot, and each mask needs a stable key that continues to identify the same region through later versions."

openIssues.span: 使用拥有所有权的图像与矩形创建结构化图片遮挡笔记。
openIssues.explanation: 新导语已说明“提供图片和矩形坐标→生成笔记”，紧接的保留句又重复一遍，且“图像”与导语的“图片”混用；导语里“批量”出现两次，“可直接导入”的主语落在笔记上（实际导入的是 APKG）。
openIssues.proposedFix: 导语：用代码生成 Anki 图片遮挡（图片挖空）卡片：提供图片和矩形坐标，Anki Forge 会生成一条笔记（每个遮罩对应一张卡片），并打包成可直接导入的 APKG。……　第二段：笔记持有图片快照的所有权；每个遮罩需要稳定键，在后续版本中继续标识同一区域。

openIssues.span: una nota con una tarjeta por máscara, lista para importar
openIssues.explanation: The two opening paragraphs repeat image/rectangle setup. Lista para importar grammatically qualifies nota, while the run section correctly directs users to import the APKG. Context resolves the intended workflow.
openIssues.proposedFix: State that the generated APKG is ready to import and combine repeated setup sentences.

openIssues.span: インポート可能なノートを作ります
openIssues.issue: The modifier calls the note importable, while the later executable task correctly identifies the APKG as the imported artifact. The next paragraph also repeats the image/rectangle setup. This follows a known minor source phrasing issue and does not prevent the task.
openIssues.suggestion: Say that the note is packaged in an importable APKG and combine repeated setup wording.

openIssues.span: Anki re-export baseline
openIssues.explanation: As a retrieval topic it names the rejected baseline case, but it is clearer with the documented restriction explicit. The page and other terms already require an original distribution APKG.
openIssues.proposedFix: invalid Anki re-export baseline

openIssues.span: 稳定笔记 ID 帮助 Anki Forge 和 Anki 识别已有笔记
openIssues.explanation: “帮助……识别”直译自 help X recognize；同句后半“仍会影响最终变化”含义偏虚。
openIssues.proposedFix: 笔记 ID 保持稳定，Anki Forge 和 Anki 才能识别已有笔记，不会把它们当作新笔记；最终更新哪些内容，仍取决于 Anki 的导入设置以及本地是否有更新的修改。

openIssues.span: 发布生成牌组的新版本
openIssues.explanation: “生成牌组”可读作动宾短语“生成（一个）牌组”，和“发布”连读有歧义。
openIssues.proposedFix: 为生成的 Anki 牌组发布新版本：保持稳定笔记 ID，以上一版原始 APKG 为基线构建，并在分发前检查比较结果。

openIssues.span: returns an owned `build::ApkgArtifact` reference
openIssues.explanation: owned直接修饰reference有歧义；应明确返回引用，产物对象持有文件。

openIssues.span: even if high-risk findings block its policy
openIssues.explanation: The policy blocks publication, rather than findings blocking the policy. Nearby sentences explain it, so the local ambiguity is minor.
openIssues.proposedFix: even if its policy blocks publication because of high-risk findings

openIssues.span: 返回拥有所有权的 `build::ApkgArtifact` 引用

openIssues.proposedFix: 返回对 `build::ApkgArtifact` 产物所有者的引用

openIssues.explanation: “保持不会失败”机械对应stay infallible，中文宜直接陈述构造函数本身不会失败。
openIssues.proposedFix: 这些构造函数本身不会失败；媒体类别在添加笔记时检查。

reviewScope: New six-language six-task actual browser tour and new SDK executions. The entire current artifact inventory was hashed. Existing minor wording observations are retained, not declared fixed. No direct Anki GUI import is claimed; APKG content and documented import boundary were checked.

readingEvidence.description: Actual localized task excerpts inspected by this reviewer, plus exact full-body/code equality against previous captured prose.

priorReadingLineage.description: Previous immutable independent reading and minor issues; only unchanged wording judgments are retained, not old execution or browser claims.
